tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures support a smooth base field with sink-gradient dependence, but the five rows cannot distinguish a single-branch response from a two-layer conjunctive siphon. The open-branch probe is the lowest-cost targeted discriminator; current gradients do not enter the cited supercritical range.

considered_alternatives.option: author a stationary four-parameter siphon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations with fixed x_now, mem_conv, and H do not resolve the competing Haldane/Cobb-Douglas explanations or establish whether a second branch contributes.
Costs more and is less directly targeted at distinguishing the open-branch ambiguity.
It is irrelevant to the stated candidate mechanisms and explicitly should not be purchased.
